correctness.rationale: The ordered-pair definition reconstructs a 12-vertex cubic graph with 18 edges and diameter three. Independent clique enumeration gives face vectors (12,18,4) at scale one and (12,42,48,12) at scale two. At scale one, four free triangle-edge collapses leave a connected graph of cycle rank three. At scale two, an independent acyclic discrete-Morse matching was constructed with 54 matched pairs and critical-cell profile one vertex, no edges, five triangles and no tetrahedra; direct orientation of the full Hasse graph is acyclic. Thus the scale-two complex is a wedge of five 2-spheres, and diameter three makes the final scale a simplex.
